title: Associate Director – Finance Controller (DESIS Finance)
jobDescription:
We are seeking a senior finance leader to take ownership of the India finance function and position it as a strategic capability within the D. E. Shaw Group's global operating framework based in Hyderabad. This role sits at the intersection of technical rigor and business judgment
- you will own the financial controls architecture across all India legal entities, drive process transformation and intelligent automation, navigate complex accounting and compliance matters in a multi-entity, cross-border structure where clear-cut answers are rare. You will operate at the highest levels of the organization, engaging with board members, regulators, senior leadership and global counterparts. We expect you to bring a point of view on how Generative AI is redefining the finance function
- not as a technologist, but as a leader with the instinct to harness it responsibly and at pace. You will also be accountable for building a finance team of enduring quality
- attracting talent, creating succession readiness and scaling institutional capability. If you are looking to shape the trajectory of a finance function rather than simply operate one, we would like to hear from you. You will own the India finance function end-to-end and position it as a strategic capability within the D. E. Shaw group's global operating framework, serving as a trusted advisor to senior leadership with a point of view grounded in both technical depth and business acumen. You will establish and continuously strengthen the financial controls architecture across all India legal entities — ensuring that accounting processes, month-end close, and audit readiness operate at the standard expected of a globally integrated finance function. You will navigate complex, ambiguous accounting and compliance matters with the judgment to take a position, the rigor to defend it, and the discipline to escalate when the risk profile warrants it, while building and owning the broader risk governance architecture that ensures financial, regulatory, and operational risks are systematically identified, assessed, and integrated with the firm's global risk framework. You will lead and deliver high-intensity, cross-functional projects from inception to outcome — aligning diverse stakeholders, holding the team to pace, removing barriers, and maintaining execution discipline through complexity and competing priorities — while influencing and aligning with cross-functional leaders to build the working relationships that move decisions forward. You will engage directly and influence at senior levels including the board of directors, audit committees, regulators, global leadership, and external advisors such as auditors, bankers, and legal counsel, representing the India finance function with credibility and executive presence in high-stakes settings with the ability to hold a position, push back constructively, and present with clarity. You will collaborate effectively with global teams on reporting timelines, governance requirements, and firm-wide initiatives, operating seamlessly across time zones and organizational boundaries. You will identify and prioritize high-impact Gen AI applications across statutory reporting, reconciliation, audit readiness, and compliance workflows — distinguishing genuine efficiency gains from implementation noise — and partner credibly with technology teams to evaluate AI tools for accuracy, governance, data integrity, and regulatory fit. You will lead the team through AI adoption with clarity, building the organizational muscle to leverage AI-assisted workflows while maintaining the judgment and control standards that a regulated finance operation demands. You will drive process transformation across the finance function including systematic ERP improvements, workflow automation, and adaptation to evolving regulatory and business requirements; identify and eliminate inefficiencies in existing processes to move the function from steady-state maintenance towards continuous improvement and operational excellence; and champion the adoption of new tools and methodologies, building the organizational readiness to absorb change without compromising control or compliance standards. You will build, scale, and develop a high-performing India finance team — owning performance management, talent development, and creating succession readiness at every level — while attracting and retaining high-caliber professionals and fostering a culture of ownership, intellectual rigor, and continuous learning. You will invest in structured development paths for direct reports, ensuring the team's institutional capability grows with the firm.

title: Analyst - Tax - Financial Operations
jobDescription: We are looking for a resourceful candidate to join our Tax team in Hyderabad, India. The Tax team is responsible for timely and accurate filings of Federal and state tax returns for U.S. entities and issuing statements (Schedule K-1s) and projections to our investors. The team does extensive tax compliance work for Partnerships and Corporations, relating to U.S. Hedge funds, U.S. Private Equity, and Management Company entities. The team performs a detailed review of tax workpapers and tax returns, a detailed analysis of financial products and their tax treatment, analyzes the book income, computes the taxable income, and its allocation to the investors using complex tax allocation methodologies. The team interacts with various internal and external stakeholders to understand the process workflows relating to trade and fund accounting and industry-wide tax practices and their reporting. The team plays a pivotal role in various tax process automation initiatives and generates tax analytical and visualization dashboards, which aid in creating efficiencies and alpha generation. Additionally, the team works with the Tax Planning team on entity structuring consultation, analyzing tax implications for new financial products, comprehending new tax regulations, and devising various strategies to optimize tax efficiency. In this role, you will be required to prepare, review, and file D. E. Shaw’s hedge investment funds income tax returns and issue annual tax information (Sch. K-1s) to investors. You will review tax information to be included in various regulatory filings (tax audits, state tax returns, etc.) and interact with D. E. Shaw’s various Financial Operations teams and the Tax Planning team. You will prepare, review, and issue quarterly investor tax estimate statements. You will compute funds’ taxable income calculations/allocations for various D. E. Shaw’s hedge funds, as well as for investors, which includes analyzing book-to-tax differences, and various taxable income allocation methodologies. You will be expected to periodically compute various state taxes, pay state tax authorities and address tax notices. Additionally, you will periodically present D. E. Shaw’s hedge funds taxable income analysis to senior management and address queries raised by investors on their taxable income calculations.

The team is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing the firm’s Windows infrastructure while working closely with other global teams in the Systems department. The role offers an opportunity to lead engineers, coordinate with other tech teams, and collaborate with the business to define the technology roadmap, oversee project execution, and ensure high-quality deliverables. You will lead a team of engineers to design, implement, and maintain reliable, scalable, and high-performance systems based on Windows technologies. Your responsibilities will include collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements, translating business needs into technical projects, setting realistic timelines and priorities, and owning complete project delivery. You will also engage in engineering project work and provide direction to enhance the overall configurability, observability, supportability, and reliability of the firm’s technology environment. Furthermore, you will upgrade and/or redesign existing infrastructure to improve performance and stability. As a techno-functional leader, you will hire, mentor, and develop engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership, and technical rigor.
